run.termination: GDB killed the inferior at the first retail software-queue wait; no clean title shutdown was observed.

packet_address_source.derivation_note: The recorded WAIT_REG_MEM decode for address field 0x1B964006 resolves to guest word 0x1B964004; this probe applied the same two-byte lane adjustment to the captured 0x1B964012 field.

observed: The exact retail XEX and recorded host, runtime, and GPU-plugin hashes match the earlier evidence set.
The command-stream builder entered with r6=0x823A4758 and armed a hardware write watchpoint at host alias 0x21B964010.
The watched host alias read zero when armed and at the first software-queue wait; the hardware watchpoint reported no writes before that wait.
At the same stop, the retail queue wait had target 13 between head 0 and tail 21, and its predicate byte was 0x14.
not_proven: That this stream packet was submitted or executed before the first software-queue wait; the packet address field is correlated from a separate capture of the same retail builder.
That no device/DMA write or write through another host alias occurred.
Which earlier GPU job, CPU producer, or visibility operation should set guest word 0x1B964010.
That this word alone causes the software-queue wait or frontend stall.
Main-menu entry, offline-race entry, or sustained visible retail output.
interpretation.next_p1_step: Identify the producer and visibility path for guest word 0x1B964010, then correlate it with command-stream submission while preserving the original WAIT_REG_MEM and queue predicates.

limitations: This was a bounded, intrusive GDB run and ended at the first software-queue wait.
Only the selected physical host alias was watched; device/DMA writes and alternate host aliases are outside the observation.
The packet address field and queue wait were not captured from the same run.
